Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the
intersection in League City, Texas. Plaese state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my first name and last initial for this, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were coming from and where you were headed when the collision
occurred?
A: I was driving through the intersection heading east on a green light. I'd just left work and was going to pick up my
kid from practice.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I caught a glimpse of it coming from my right, maybe a second before it hit my driver's side. I tried to
brake but there wasn't time.
Q: How fast do you estimate you were traveling?
A: Around thirty-five, maybe a bit under. It's a busy stretch but I wasn't speeding.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Where did you feel pain after the collision?
A: My left knee took the brunt of it. It hit the dashboard and the door frame. It sweleld up pretty quickly and I could
barely put weight on it at first.
Q: Did you receive medical attention?
A: Paramedics checked me at the scene, and I went to urgent care later that same day. They took X-rays and told me
to follow up with an orthopedic doctor, which I've scheduled.
Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that knee?
A: No, nothing serious. I played sports in school, but I haven't had any treatment on it in years.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm still having trouble with stairs and driving for long stretches. I'd like to be made whole for what this has
cost me.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
